_readme: Fox stickers for the composer's picker. Content, not code: add or edit an entry here and the picker, the web app and the APK all follow. Each sticker draws inside a 64x64 box, is inserted into a message as [fox:id], and is rendered back to the picture in the bubble. Keywords are lowercase and also carry the Persian so a learner can search in either language. The drawings are generated by tools/build_foxes.py from one shared fox vocabulary, so edit the pose there and re-run it rather than hand-patching a path here.
